mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a cool 48 degrees with moderate drizzle near Verona City Hall. Under the New Moon, we have a clear sky tonight, which means you can catch the International Space Station passing over for three minutes starting at 5:43 PM; it will rise in the south over Belleville and track east toward Fitchburg, staying low near the horizon.

Important updates for the city include candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election being available at the Clerk's Office. Additionally, the Military Ridge State Trail paving project continues, with a public meeting regarding the design and trail closures scheduled for December 8 at the Verona Senior Center.

There is plenty to do in town. Today, you can catch live music at Paddy Mac's, attend yoga at Insight Wellness, or enjoy Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to Trivia Night at both The Mill and The Bogey Factory, plus Art House 360 events.
Looking at recent reports, on October 25, officers located a 40-year-old man passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is currently open, so make sure to stop by before closing time at 10:00 PM.
